name: Workflow
summary: Run reviewable, resumable AI workflows — interactive or headless — against your own BFFless project.

manualSteps.title: Set PUBLIC_ORIGIN (local storage only)
manualSteps.body: On local-FS storage, presigned media URLs are relative and island viewers cannot resolve them. Set PUBLIC_ORIGIN on the backend so signed URLs are absolute.

manualSteps.title: Publish an implementation
manualSteps.body: The harness starts empty. Publish an implementation (e.g. hello) into project {projectPath} with bffless/publish-workflow — see the workflow-implementations repo.
